name: Elena Popescu
bio:
Elena Popescu's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional. After spending years in corporate HR, she found herself increasingly drawn to the fast-paced, high-stakes environment of racing through a family friend who worked as a mechanic. Intrigued by the dedication and teamwork required, she made a career pivot, bringing her considerable HR expertise to Hendrick Motorsports.

As an HR Manager, Elena focuses on fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. Her approach is rooted in open communication and a deep understanding of the unique challenges faced by individuals in the demanding world of motorsport. Elena's ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances and her commitment to continuous improvement make her a crucial asset to the team. She is known for her dedication to finding the right talent and ensuring that everyone has the resources and support they need to thrive.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, softly waved, often pulled back into a low ponytail
physical.description: Elena is a woman of average height with a warm smile and a kind demeanor, often seen wearing practical, professional attire.

quirks: Always has a supply of traditional Romanian candies in her office for visitors
Keeps a detailed log of every team member's birthday and makes a point to acknowledge each one personally
Does a daily crossword puzzle during her lunch break, claiming it helps her stay sharp
